title: 第11章 感恩陈相第12章 谨言慎行
slug: 苟住开局长生修仙只是副业
content_zh:
第一千九百六十七位？！
林铭猜测着这数字的意义！
何掌柜已然是笑呵呵地给林铭介绍着：
“林相公，我们书楼是陈相建立的，目的就是为了让天下没有钱读书，还想要读书的人都能够有书读，我们书楼的规矩很少，算起来唯有一条，凡是免费借阅，或者是低价租赁的，都要在登记借书和还书的时候说上一句，感谢陈相爷！”
“感谢陈相爷！”
刘晨在一旁诚心诚意，自发地跟着说了起来！
林铭见状，也跟着说了一句。
“感谢陈相爷！”
见林铭能够说出感谢的话，何掌柜并不再要求其他，一指书柜的方向，说道：
“好，就这一条规矩，林相公能够遵循即可，可以去挑书了！书架的两侧挂着木牌，上面写明了租书的价目……”
“谢过掌柜！”
刘晨已然先拱手说着：
“何掌柜，接下来就交给我吧，我带着大哥去熟悉一下整个书楼的布局！”
“辛苦刘老爷！”
林铭也同样对何掌柜拱了拱手，跟在刘晨的身后重新向着书架的方向而去，对林铭介绍着：
“大哥，书楼一层二层的书库主要是按照经史子集四部分进行划分的，一层是经史，二层是子集，经又包括易类、书类……”
……
在刘晨的介绍之下，林铭对整个寒门书楼的布局也有了一个大概的了解。
经史子集，这四个分类之中，读书之人看得最多的肯定是经类！
这是科考重点考察的分类，凡是为了科考之人，都必须要先看这个分类！

林铭要是为了科考，肯定也会先看这个分类的，可惜，他并不是为了科考，他来这里另有目的。
刘晨给林铭介绍完之后，就对林铭说着：
“大哥，该介绍的都差不多了，剩下的你自己找书看看，我也去找一本，我们三楼阅读室汇合，有什么疑问的话，随时可以问我！”
“好，多谢。”
刘晨从经类拿了一本《孝经》返回到了何掌柜的那边，进行了登记。
林铭对经类没有什么兴趣，而是前往史类！
唐太宗曾经说过，读史可以明智，知古方能鉴今。
在这个世界之中，想要明晰国朝定律，林铭需要首先了解的，依旧是历史！
他首先拿了一本《太祖史》到了何掌柜的面前，轻声说道：
“何掌柜，我想借这本书，到上面阅读一下！感谢陈相爷！”
“好，我给你登记一下！”
何掌柜拿出了一个空的本子，在扉页上写着林铭的编号，在第一页上写着时间，借书《太祖史》，楼内观看！
“可以了！林相公可以上去了！”
“谢谢。”
拿着书籍，林铭上了三楼，只见三楼有着几个方桌，每个方桌的四周围着书生，少则几人，多则十几人，他们有的正阅读着自己的，也有的几个人小声的议论着某本书，说着自己的感悟！
林铭一上楼，就看到不远处的刘晨对着他连连摆手，轻声说着：
“大哥，这边！”
content_en:
Number 1967? !
Lin Ming guessed at the meaning of this number!
Shopkeeper He was already introducing Lin Ming with a smile:
"Ms. Lin, our library was established by Prime Minister Chen. The purpose is to allow people in the world who have no money to study and still want to study to have books to read. There are very few rules in our library. There is only one rule. Anyone who borrows books for free or rents them at a low price must say "Thank you, Mr. Chen" when registering to borrow or return books!"
"Thank you Mr. Chen!"
Liu Chen spoke sincerely and spontaneously!
When Lin Ming saw this, he also said something.
"Thank you Mr. Chen!"
Seeing that Lin Ming was able to express his gratitude, Shopkeeper He did not ask for anything else. He pointed to the direction of the bookcase and said:
"Okay, as long as Mr. Lin can follow this rule, you can go pick out books! There are wooden signs hanging on both sides of the bookshelf, which indicate the price of renting books..."
"Thank you, shopkeeper!"
Liu Chen already held up his hands and said:
"Shopkeeper He, leave the next step to me. I will take my eldest brother to get familiar with the layout of the entire library!"
"Thank you, Mr. Liu!"
Lin Ming also bowed to Shopkeeper He and followed Liu Chen towards the bookshelf again, introducing Lin Ming:
"Brother, the library on the first and second floors of the library is mainly divided into four parts according to the classics and history subsets. The first floor is classics and history, the second floor is subsets, and classics includes the Yi category and the book category..."
…
After Liu Chen's introduction, Lin Ming also had a general understanding of the layout of the entire Hanmen Library.
Among the four categories of classics and history, the classics category is definitely the most read by readers!
This is the classification that the scientific examination focuses on. Anyone who wants to take the scientific examination must read this classification first!
If Lin Ming was doing it for the scientific examination, he would definitely look at this category first. Unfortunately, he was not doing it for the scientific examination. He came here for another purpose.
After Liu Chen introduced Lin Ming, he said to Lin Ming:
"Brother, that's all that needs to be introduced. For the rest, you can find a book and read it yourself. I'll also find one. Let's meet in the reading room on the third floor. If you have any questions, you can ask me at any time!"
"Okay, thank you."
Liu Chen took a copy of "The Classic of Filial Piety" from the classics and returned it to Shopkeeper He, where he registered it.
Lin Ming had no interest in classics, but went to history!
Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty once said that reading history can make you wise, and knowing the past can help you learn from the present.
In this world, if he wants to understand the laws of the country and the dynasty, the first thing Lin Ming needs to understand is still history!
He first took a copy of "History of Taizu" to Shopkeeper He and said softly:
"Shopkeeper He, I would like to borrow this book and read it! Thank you, Mr. Chen!"
"Okay, let me register it for you!"
Shopkeeper He took out an empty notebook, wrote Lin Ming's number on the title page, and wrote the time on the first page. He borrowed the book "History of Taizu" and watched it in the building!
"That's it! Mr. Lin can go up!"
"Thank you."
Taking the books, Lin Ming went up to the third floor. He saw several square tables on the third floor. Each square table was surrounded by scholars, ranging from a few people to more than a dozen. Some of them were reading their own books, while others were discussing a certain book in a low voice and talking about their own insights!
As soon as Lin Ming went upstairs, he saw Liu Chen not far away waving to him and saying softly:
"Brother, this way!"
